title: Origin story: Atalanta
description: Atalanta was exposed at birth by a father who wanted a son, suckled by a she-bear, and raised by hunters in the Arcadian wilds. She became the swiftest mortal alive, sailed with the Argonauts, and vowed to marry only the man who could outrun her — losers paid with their lives, until Hippomenes beat her with three golden apples.
